meta.title: Santa Present Park Marose Ski Area
meta.description: 15–20 minutes by car from downtown Asahikawa. Family snow play and night skiing with city views.

transit.title:
From Asahikawa
to the snow.
transit.lead: About 15–20 minutes by car from JR Asahikawa Station, or roughly 30 minutes from Asahikawa Airport—the local hill for a zoo morning and night-ski evening without leaving the city orbit.
transit.imgAlt: Car on a snowy road at dusk heading toward slopes with Asahikawa city lights

primary.title: Kids area & snow escalator
primary.lead: A free kids slope separate from the main hill, loading carpets on lifts, and a snow escalator for first-timers. The parent–child daytime set ticket is ¥6,000 (2025–26 official) for an easy family day.
primary.imgAlt: Families playing in the kids snow area at Santa Present Park Marose

secondary.title: Night skiing over the city
secondary.lead: Night tickets from 16:00 are ¥1,800 adults / ¥1,100 children (2025–26 official). Ski with Asahikawa's night skyline below—World Cup–grade powder lines for after-work or pre-hotel sessions.

onsen.title:
After skiing,
soak in Asahikawa.
onsen.lead: Within about 30–60 minutes by car: Yusk Isamu no Yu in Asahikawa, Tenninkyo Onsen, and the Sounkyo spa cluster—classic recovery loops after night skiing.
onsen.whisper: Staying in Asahikawa? Zoo by day, slopes at dusk, onsen at night is the standard three-act day.
onsen.imgAlt: Snow-view outdoor bath in the Asahikawa region

powder.title: World Cup powder & six courses
powder.body: Two Snowboard World Cup events hosted here. Six courses for beginner through advanced, longest run about 1,000 m and max pitch around 25° (official). Chase fresh lines close to the city without big-resort crowds.

shinkansen.title: From station or airport
shinkansen.body: 15–20 minutes by car from Asahikawa Station, about 30 from the airport. Dohoku Bus "Santa Present Park" line takes roughly 25 minutes from the station (terminus stop). Pick up a rental at Asahikawa Airport for zoo + slopes in one day.

beginners.title: Beginners & families
beginners.body: Free kids slope, snow escalator ¥1,500 unlimited 10:00–15:00 (official), and sled zones—built for first snow days. Free parking for 1,500 vehicles (official) makes family drives easy.

access.note: About 15–20 min by car from JR Asahikawa Station · ~30 min from Asahikawa Airport · Open 9:00–21:00 (night 16:00–)
